title: Document domain_lo zero and V4 corporate INIT policy gap
brief: Clarify that the future corporate-sector domain model reserves domain_lo=0 in each production base cluster for non-rented generic company registration, with company metadata and emergency routing policy carried by a V4 INIT extension. Keep current Phase 1B runtime domain_index.rs unchanged.

delegations.prompt_summary: Document the semantic gap and future V4/V5 boundary without runtime code changes.
Doc-only review: domain_lo=0 vs rented lo>0, v0/v3 INIT vs V4, no false implication of current domain_index.rs support.

notes: Owner clarified expected semantics: domain_lo=0 in each future corporate-sector cluster is intended for a company that does not rent its own domain namespace and registers through metadata in INIT. V4 INIT extension is also expected to support emergency routing policy. This is currently under-specified in RFCs. pwm-review (2026-05-16): PASS_WITH_NITS — cross-links and DOMAINS explicit non-change of domain_index.rs OK; optional nit about the CONCEPT_ROADMAP lease-principles wording was auto-closed by explicitly splitting domain_lo > 0 rental semantics from domain_lo = 0 root/generic registration.
